method: text/source contract comparison only after project design sealing; no root edit or execution

focused_corrections.location: Typed interface / Ownership and enrollment / Replacement protocol
focused_corrections.finding: The envelope/profile and custody list preserve attended execution but do not explicitly freeze the terminal device, controlling session, stdio descriptors and foreground group across managed restart. Initial unmanaged same-TTY inheritance is not supported by inspected primitives.
focused_corrections.suggested_change: Include an exact inherited TTY/session/descriptor binding in the launch profile and native custody/return receipts. Require same TTY for managed replacements. Mark unmanaged same-TTY transfer a separate missing integration; initial new managed TTY would require an explicit owner-approved binding change, not implied by automation design.

focused_corrections.finding: The proposed entry owns the direct Codex child; MCP adapter processes may be its grandchildren. wait/reap authority is held by the true parent/provider, not obtained from a PID/start or disappearance observation.
focused_corrections.suggested_change: Require actual direct-child wait/reap receipt from its owning supervisor and supported adapter exit/drain/reap evidence from their actual owners. Do not claim every adapter was reaped by the project supervisor unless native custody supports that. Unknown child/read/scene custody blocks new launch.
